On the 105th anniversary of the Communist Party of China we reflect on the extraordinary path taken by the CPC, changing the course of history in the pursuit of socialism, people’s liberation, environmental justice and a future of peaceful cooperation against war and fascism.

The Communist Party of Australia (CPA) sends its deepest message of solidarity with the Venezuelan people, the Bolivarian government, all progressive organisations, unions, grass roots communes, and our fraternal comrades in the Communist Party of Venezuela.

The Communist Party of Australia (CPA) mourns the passing of Ramiro Valdés Menéndez, Commander and hero of the Cuban Revolution.

The Communist Party of Australia (CPA) warmly congratulates the Communist Party of Chile on your 114th anniversary. We also extend our thoughts to your Party as you commemorate the 50th anniversary of the detainment, torture, execution and forced disappearance of your leadership in the Caso Calle Conferencia, Pinochet’s covert operations to undermine the Communist Party in 1976.

The Communist Party of Australia, condemns in the strongest possible terms the latest act of aggression by the BJP-led government against the Communist Party of India (Marxist).

The Communist Party of Australia stands in solidarity with the Maritime Union of Australia and its members in their crucial struggle to oppose the proposed automation and AI driven operations at DP World’s four Australian terminals (Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne, and Fremantle).

The US indictment of Raúl Castro on 20 May is yet another desperate attempt to attack the heart of the Cuban Revolution.

Fraternal greetings from the Communist Party of Australia (CPA) on the centenary anniversary of the Communist Party of Ecuador (PCE).

The Communist Party of Australia (CPA) has a consistent policy to support the one China principle and supports the People’s Republic of China in its efforts for national reunification.

The Central Committee (CC) of the Communist Party of Australia (CPA) condemns in the strongest terms the escalating war being waged by the United States and Israel against the peoples of Iran, Lebanon and Palestine, and declares its unwavering solidarity with all those resisting imperialism and Zionism.

The Communist Party of Australia (CPA) salutes the heroic Democratic Front for the Liberation of Palestine (DFLP) on the 57th anniversary of your founding and your ongoing resistance.

The Communist Party of Australia and our Central Committee International Department extend our warmest wishes to the heroic Communist Party of Israel (CPI) on the occasion of your 29th Congress, which is to be held under the banner of ‘Organisational and Ideological Revival and a Shield Against Fascism.’

The Central Committee condemns in the strongest possible terms the recent attacks by the Trump regime on Cuba, calling a so-called “national emergency” to designate Cuba as an unusual threat to US national security and call for a total blockade.

The Communist Party of Australia (CPA) wishes the Communist Party of Sri Lanka all the very best for your upcoming 23rd Congress.

The Communist Party of Australia unequivocally condemns the Trump administration’s illegal military attack against Venezuela, including the forcible kidnapping of President Nicolás Maduro and his wife Cilia Flores, carried out in blatant violation of international law.
